parameters.question: Compare Cox LASSO-selected feature results (hazard ratios, 95% CIs, p-values). Features with |HR-1|>0.5 in the reference must be present with the same direction of effect (HR>1 vs HR<1); for features present in both, HR must match within 20% relative error. Column order, row order and header labels may differ; minor differences in which borderline features are selected are acceptable.
